categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Lacks the Build system label and modifies contrib/verify-binaries, a post-release verification script for users rather than the build, Guix, depends, or CI systems.
categories.rationale: Does not belong to build. The changes affect client-side release binary verification scripts rather than the build system, CI pipelines, or release packaging infrastructure.

categories.name: tools
categories.evidence: Carries the Scripts and tools label and modifies contrib/verify-binaries/verify.py and test.py.
categories.rationale: Fixes a security flaw in binary verification where expired or revoked keys counted toward quorum. As reported via Red Team disclosure, the verifier 'counted signatures with EXPKEYSIG or REVKEYSIG statuses toward the --min-good-sigs threshold, allowing binary verification to succeed entirely on expired or revoked keys.'
